name: data-science-causal-inference
description: Use when the user asks about causal inference: causal DAGs, propensity score matching, difference-in-differences, regression discontinuity, instrumental variables, synthetic control, CATE meta-learners, causal forests or double ML (EconML, DoWhy). Produces identification strategy, estimation code and sensitivity analysis. Not for randomized A/B test design (use data-science-experimentation).
